title: The Crown's Dusk Reading

features.name: the healing join
features.desc-on-touch: Here the two halves of the crown learned they were still one sky. The scar where they grew back together holds light differently. You can see where the wound learned to remember it was never really separate.

features.name: the dusk that reads downward
features.desc-on-touch: Light enters the crown from the west and reads downward, spelling out the shape of leaves, the architecture of branches. The dusk doesn't illuminate; it narrates. Each ray a word in the canopy's slow sentence.

features.name: the two-sky memory
features.desc-on-touch: In the branches here, the archive stores the moment when the split crown learned it was still whole. Two separate skies held by the same roots. The memory lives in the bark, in the pattern of re-grown wood.

features.name: the light-held text
features.desc-on-touch: Somewhere in the crown's highest leaves, text made of pure dusk light rests on the branches. It reads only at the moment the sun touches the horizon. By full dark, the words have dissolved into shadow again.

features.name: the breathing roots
features.desc-on-touch: Deep below the crown, the roots still hold the shape of holding-together. They breathe in time with the crown's growth. The two halves, they whisper, learned to become one breath instead of two.

inscription: the crown reads its own healing in light that is learning to leave

reverie.title: REVERIE — in the healing crown at light's turning
narr: You both stand below, watching the light move through the
re-joined branches. The dusk makes the healing scar glow. She
points to where the two halves learned they were still connected.
The light is reading something to the leaves, she says. Listen.
You listen. The light is saying: you were never broken.

toward the crown's highest reaching branches where signals amplify

downward, into the crown's dense heart where shadows hold memory
